title: Iron Hippo's Iron Hands (Grip Program)
author: Iron Hippo
desc: This simple 6-week program is designed to give you a death grip capable of lifting any weird object with your hands.  Choose two main lifts for the whole 6 weeks.  Change out the main lifts every time you cycle through the program.

Your secondary hold.  Choose a weight you can do for 10+ seconds.  Choose a different implement every week.
